senses.gloss:
(इ) कपि r. 1st cl. (कंपते)
To shake, to tremble:
with अनु prefixed,
to feel tenderness or compassion, to pity.

mn. (-टः-टं)
Fraud, deceit, cheating, circumvention.
E.
क. BRAHMĀ, पट to go, अच् affix; what extends even to BRAHMĀ; or क the head, and पट a covering, screening the head as it were.
f. (-टी)
A measure equal to the capacity of the hollows of the two hands joined.

mfn. (-टः-टी-टं)
A door, the leaf or pannel of a door.
E.
क the head or wind, पट to go, अण् affix; also कबाट.

f. (-ता)
Deceitfulness.
E.
तल् added to कपट्; also with त्व, कपटत्वं.

m. (-न्धः)
Fraud, trick, fraudulent plot or contrivance.
E.
कपट, and प्रबन्ध procedure.

n. (-ख्यं)
A forged document, a false or fraudulent statement.
E.
कपट, and लेख्य a writing.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Masked, disguised, assuming a false dress or appearance.
m. (-शः)
Disguise.
E.
कपट, and वेश costume.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Disguised, in masquerade.
E.
कपटवेश and इनि aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
A rogue, a cheat, fraudulent, dishonest.
E.
कपट and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Wicked, bad, perverse.
2 Fraudulent, dishonest.
m. (-कः)
1 A student, a scholar.
2 A flatterer, a parasite.
E.
कपट fraud, &c. ठक् aff.

mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि)
Fraudulent, dishonest, a cheat, &c.
E.
कपट and इनि aff.

m. (-र्द्दः)
1 The braided hair of ŚIVA.
2 A small shell used as a coin, a Cowri.
3 A name of ŚIVA.
E.
क water, (that of the Ganges,) पृ in the deriv. form, nourishing, and द from दा to give; or क happiness, &c. which will apply to both senses; also with कन् added कपर्द्दक.

m. (-कः)
See the preceding.

m. (-र्द्दी)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
कपर्द्द his braided hair, and इनि aff.

m. (-घ्नः)
A thief, a house-breaker.
E.
कपाट, and घ्न who breaks.

m. (-न्धिः)
1 The junction of the leaves of a door.
2 A mode of multiplying, (in arithmetic.)
E.
कपाट, and सन्धि junction.

m. (-लः-लं)
1 The skull, the cranium.
2 Either half of a water jar.
3 Any flat bone.
4 A beggar's bowl.
5 Multitude, assemblage, collection.
6 A species of leprosy.
7 A treaty of peace on equal terms.
E.
कपि to tremble, and कालन् Uṇādi affix; or क the head, and पाल what cherishes or protects.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Cranial, relating to the skull.
m. (-लः)
A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.)
n. (-लं)
A sort of leprosy.
E.
कपाल and अण् aff.

f. (-का)
A sort of pin or spindle for winding cotton, thread, &c.

m. (-भृत्)
A name of MAHĀDEVA.
E.
कपाल a skull, and भृत् who cherishes; being represented with a necklace of skulls.

f. (-न्धिः)
Treaty of peace on equal terms.
E.
कपाल, and सन्धि peace.

f. (-का)
1 The tartar of the teeth.
2 A potsherd.
E.
कपाल and कन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating or belonging to the skull.
m. (-कः)
A worshipper of ŚIVA of the left-hand order, characterised by carrying a half of the skull as a cup, drinking spirituous liquors, &c.
E.
कपाल, and ठञ् aff.

m. (-ली)
1 A title of ŚIVA.
2 A man of low caste, from a Brahman mother and fisherman father.
f. (-नी)
The goddess DURGĀ.
E.
कपाल a skull, इनि affix; and ङीष् fem. do.

m. (-पिः)
1 An ape or monkey.
2 The monkey HANUMĀN.
3 A title of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA.
4 Incense, storax or impure benzoin.
5 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.)
6 A kind of Bonduc or Bonducella.
E.
कपि to tremble, इ Uṇādi affix, the nasal rejected.

f. (-च्छुः)
Cowach, (Dolichos carpopogon.)
E.
कपि a monkey, and कच्छु itching; also with final vowel long कपिकच्छू.

f. (-च्छुः)
Cowach: see कपिकच्छु.

f. (-रा)
Cowach: see the preceding.

n. (-कं)
The skull, the cranium.
E.
कपि, and कन्दुक a ball.

m. (-तः)
A tree, (Spondias mangifera): see आम्रातक.
E.
कपि, and चूत the mango tree, the monkey's mango.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born of a monkey, &c.
m. (-जः)
Incense, benzoin.
E.
कपि, and ज born.

m. (-लः)
1 A bird, the francoline partridge.
2 The Chataka.

n. (-लः)
Benzoin or storax.
E.
कपि, and तैल oil.

m. (-त्थः)
The elephant or wood apple, (Feronia elephantum.)
E.
कपि, and त्थ from स्था to stay or abide; the residence of apes.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, commonly कपित्थानी, the leaves of which are compared to those of the preceding.

f. (-नी)
A plant: see the preceding.

m. (-स्यः)
A kind of monkey.
E.
कपित्थ, and आस्य a face; having a roundish face, in shape like the wood apple.

m. (-जः)
A name of ARJUNA.
E.
कपि a monkey, and ध्वज a sign; having a monkey as his symbol, his ensign or arms.

m. (-मा)
Incense: see कपि.

f. (-भा)
Cowach: see कपिकच्छु.

m. (-भुः)
A name of the first RĀMA.
E.
कपि, and प्रभु master; general of the monkey force with which he invaded Laṅkā or Ceylon.

m. (-यः)
The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ.
E.
कपि and प्रिय beloved.

m. (-थः)
A title of RĀMA.
E.
कपि and रथ a car; having been carried by his monkies.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Tawny.
m. (-लः)
1 KAPILA, a celebrated Muni or saint, the founder of the Sāṃkhya system of philosophy: the son of KĀRDDAMA by DEVAHŪTI, and according to some, an avatāra of VIṢṆU.
2 A title of AGNI the deity of fire.
3 A dog.
5 Tawny, (the colour.)
f. (-ला)
1 The female elephant of the south-east.
2 A kind of Sisu, or timber tree so [] called: see शिंशपा.
3 A sort of perfume: see रेणुका.
4 The aloe plant.
5 A fabulous cow, celebrated in the Purāṇas.
5 The common leech.
E.
कभ to desire, इलच् Uṇādi affix, and प substituted for म; or कपि a monkey, and ल to take, &c. being of such a colour.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Of a tawny colour.
m. (-लः)
1 A follower of the Sāṃkhya system of philosophy.
E.
कपिल the founder of the school, and अण् affix.
2 Tawny, (the colour.)
E.
अण् pleonastic, added to कपिल, q. v.

m. (-तिः)
A name of SŪRYA or the sun.
E.
कपिल, and द्युति light; being of a dull red or tawny hue.

f. (-क्षा)
The brown or tawny grape.
E.
कपिल, and द्राक्षा a grape.

m. (-मः)
The name of a perfume or sweet scented wood: see काक्षी.

f. (-रा)
1 The Ganges.
2 A holy place, a place of pilgrimage.

m. (-श्वः)
A title of the god INDRA.
E.
कपिल tawny, and अश्व horse; such being the colour of INDRA'S steed.

n. (-हं)
Brass.
E.
कपि for कपिल brown, and लोह iron.

f. (-का)
A plant, which bears a seed resembling pepper, (Pothos officinalis.)

m. (-क्त्रः)
A name of NĀRADA, a saint and philosopher, and friend of KṚṢṆA.
E.
कपि, and वक्त्र a face; the saint having a face like a monkey.

f. (-ल्ली)
The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ.
E.
कपि, and वल्ली a pedicle; that being invested with a downy coat, resembling the hair of an ape.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Brown, of a brown colour.
m. (-शः)
1 Brown, (the colour,) a compound of black and yellow.
2 Incense, styrax or coarse benzoin.
f. (-शी)
A spirit, a sort of rum.
f. (-शा)
The mother of the demons called Piśācas.
E.
कपि an ape, and शः affix; of the colour of an ape.

n. (-शं)
A spirituous liquor, wine.
f. (-शी)
A country.
E.
कपिश brown, and अण् aff.

m. (-नः)
A title of ŚIVA.

m. (-नः)
1 A deity.
2 A sort of spirit or rum.
E.
कपिशा, affix फक्.

m. (-नः)
1 A deity.
2 A kind of vinous liquor.
n. (-नं)
Honey.
f. (-नी)
A grape.
E.
कपिश brown, or कापिशी a country, and ष्फक् aff.

m. (-त्रः)
A Piśāca, an imp or goblin.
E.
कपिशा the mother of these beings, and पुत्र a son.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Embrowned, made brown or dusky red.
E.
कपिश and इतच् aff.

f. (-का)
Spirituous liquor.
E.
कपिश, and ईकन् affix: see कपिश.

n. (-र्षः)
The upper part or coping of a wall.
E.
कपि, and शीर्ष the head; a monkey's head.

n. (-कं)
Vermilion, the red sulphuret of mercury.

n. (-लं)
A place frequented by monkies.
E.
कपि, and स्थल place.

m. (-ज्यः)
A plant, (a species of mimusops): see क्षीरिका.
E.
कपि, and इज्य respected, liked: a favourite plant with the monkies; also कपीज्यक.

m. (-नः)
1 A tree bearing an acid fruit, (Spondias mangifera): see आम्रातक.
2 Another tree, (Hibiscus populneoides): see गर्द्दभाण्ड.
3 A species of Mimosa, (Mimosa sirisha, Rox.)
4 The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
5 The betel nut tree, (Areca faufel or Catechu.)
6 The name of another plant, (Crataeva marmelos.)
E.
कपि an ape, and तन what spreads; sheltering or feeding monkies; the vowel is made long irregularly.

m. (-न्द्रः)
1 A name of the celebrated monkey HANUMĀN.
2 Also of SUGRĪVA, &c.
E.
कपि, and इन्द्र the chief.

f. (-का)
A patch of hair on each side of the head.
E.
क the head, पुष्टि cherishing, कन् aff.

n. (-लं)
Hair hanging down to the ground.
E.
क the head, पुच्छ a tail, and ल what resembles.

m. (-तः)
1 A dove or pigeon, especially the spotted necked pigeon.
2 A bird in general.
E.
कब to tinge, to be of various hues, आतच् Uṇādi affix, ब changed to प.

mfn. (-तः-ती-तं)
Of a dirty white colour.
m. (-तः)
1 Natron, fossile alkali.
2 Antimony, considered as a collyrium or application to the eyes.
3 A pale or dirty white colour.
n. (-तं)
A flock of pigeons.
E.
कपोत a pigeon, &c. अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
Antimony.
E.
कपोत, and कन् affix, implying resemblance, (in colour.)

f. (-णा)
A perfume: see नली.

f. (-का)
A dove cot, an aviary or pigeon house.
E.
कपोत a bird, &c. पाल to nourish, and वुन् affix, fem. termination टाप्; also with the affixes अण and ङीप्, कपोतपाली.

f. (-ली)
See the preceding.

n. (-रं)
Antimony.
E.
कपोत, and सार essence.

f. (-ङ्घ्रिः)
A perfume: see नली.
E.
कपोत, and अङ्घ्रि a foot; of a red colour, like the claw of a pigeon.

m. (-भः)
A pale or dirty white colour.
E.
कपोत, and आङ् before भा to shine, affix ड; of the colour of a pigeon.

m. (-रिः)
A hawk, a falcon.
E.
कपोत, and अरि an enemy.

f. (-का)
A done.
E.
कपोत a pigeon, कन् affix fem. form.

m. (-लः)
A cheek.
f. (-ली)
The forepart of the knee, the knee-cap or pan.
E.
कपि to quiver, and ओलच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-षः)
The elephant's temples and cheeks.
E.
कपोल, and काष a touchstone; being of the like dark colour.

m. (-त्तिः)
The temples and cheek, the upper part of the face.
E.
कपोल, and भित्ति a wall.

m. (-गः)
Colour or flush in the cheek.
E.
कपोल, and राग colour.

f. (-कः)
The cheek.
E.
कपोल, and फलक a plank.

m. (-ख्यः)
Incense.
E.
कपि, and आख्या aff.

n. (-ट्यं)
Wickedness, fraud, dishonesty.
E.
कपट, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-थः)
A bad road.
E.
का for कु bad, vile, and पथिन् a road.

m. (-यः)
A Piśāca, an imp or goblin.
E.
कपिश, and ढक् aff.

m. (-षः)
A mean contemptible man, a coward, a wretch.
E.
का for कु bad, vile, पुरुष a man.

n. (-त्वं)
Meanness, cowardliness.
E.
त्व added to the preceding: also with तल्, कापुरुषता.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Belonging to or relating to a monkey.
E.
कपि a monkey, and ढक् aff.

n. (-नं)
Antimony, especially considered as a collyrium.
E.
कपोत a pigeon, and अञ्जन a collyrium.

m. (-रः)
A penitent, one who acknowledges his faults.
E.
का for कु bad, आप्य having obtained, and कर who does; from कृ and अच्.

m. (-रः)
1 Avowal or confession of sin.
2 A penitent, one who confesses a crime.
E.
as before, affix अण्.
